method: Rows = inventory-prop.json items in order (128). For every id: (1) catalogue lookup in custom_components/junghome_ble/jhmesh/properties.py by regex r'(?:PropertySpec|_fw)\((0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}), "([a-z0-9_]+)", "([a-z_]+)"' (sig_*/sensor server -> SIG table), codec class compared with the inventory encoding (size, endianness, scale, sentinel, bit layout, access byte, firmware gate, products); (2) HA surface: config_entities.descriptions() (codec->platform map, enumerated by importing the module in .venv) plus dedicated target builders (device_lock_targets, edge_detection_targets, key_mode_targets, night_mode_targets, gateway_status_targets, blind_targets, property_id_targets, threshold_targets) and grep -rnP '0x<ID>\b|\b<spec name>\b' over custom_components and tools (climate, cover, sensor, binary_sensor, switch, select, number, button, energy_history, thresholds, tls, coordinator, mesh_config, keep_awake, commission NOT_COVERED); (3) tests: the same grep over tests/, each hit mapped to its enclosing def test_*; a test counts only if it exercises the codec vector or the entity/service behaviour of that id (catalogue-membership asserts alone do not make 'implemented'); (4) status: implemented = code + behaviour-level test and every app behaviour in the inventory details present (a product-wide FW gate or UI placement counts); partial = code exists but an app behaviour named in the details (commissioning write/read, flow, option, debug message) is missing or untested; gap = no code; na = the app itself has no behaviour for the id (Kotlin TODO() resolvers, never sent), citing docs/android/properties.md §5 q.6. Meta/model rows: messages.py vendor_property_*/generic_property_*/sensor_* builders, tools/cli_ops.py property_get/property_set/property_status_text, config_entities._on_vendor_property_status. Line numbers are 1-based at the time of writing. Adversarial verification: every code citation checked to exist (file, line within length) and every test citation to name a def in its file; properties.py citations checked to carry the row's id on the cited line; the 15 na rows re-derived from the jadx dispatchers (threshold/devices/d.java cases 8/11/19-22/25-28/default and resolver/A0.java cases 5/6/15/26 are all `throw null`, and each na capability class P8.a/c/e-j/l-p/u/y is referenced only by its resolver and the dispatcher); partial rows refuted by grepping custom_components, tools and tests for the id, the spec name and the app behaviour named in `missing`; 17 implemented rows spot-checked against the app encoders (D8/a + C8/c/f lock function, J8/C0541i lock flags, B7/a astro register, L0 threshold, edge detection, J7/b charts, Position, Duration, DimMode access 1, BlindMode/HvacMode enums, FW gates) and their cited tests read. Citations: every `code` entry is now `path::symbol` (docs/parity/README.md, Row schema), converted from `path:line` by reading each line in the tree its ledger line was written against (git blame), following it through every later re-pointing that kept the cited text and past the merges that re-pointed lines to other code, and naming the innermost symbol holding it; `tools/parity.py check` verifies each symbol is defined.
